description: GPU scripts, memory measurement and documentation of milestone 6 (plan.md items 17-20): verify_dali_pipeline.py check (l) for DeformPipeline image/label alignment (residual off: exact label match per identified case across epoch boundaries; residual on: TF re-warp of image (linear) and labels (nearest) with the emitted T), run_overfit_glacier.sh mode dryrun_deform (deform-only and rigid:1,affine:1,deform:2 20-step real-data runs with validation and PNGs) with check_mixed_run.py extended for deform (+ a stdlib unit test), tests/gpu/measure_deform_memory.py with local measurements (N = 4, 8, 16; narrow/default; gradient checkpointing), design.md v3.7 and .agents/tasks/milestone-6/report.md. Depends on FEAT-001..003. Nothing here runs on the cluster; the scripts are only syntax/unit checked locally (plus the local memory run).
